descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Gunny of Omega Sector.
descriptions.inProgress: I met up with Gunny again at a field around Omega Sector. Lately Gunny has been on a mission to trace Chief Gray's every move, but due to the fact that he gets lost easily, he had been having trouble locating it. I'll need to defeat Chief Gray's for  Gunny and collect 5 signs that they wear with them, so I can give them to Gunny.\n\n#t4000125# #b#c4000125##k/5
descriptions.completed: I collected Chief Gray's signs and gave them to Gunny, who's at a field around Omega Sector. With this sign, Gunny may be able to have an easier time tracing Chief Gray.
